about_the_game:
Dive into this Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure game — a story-rich, point-and-click mystery that blends exploration, puzzle-solving, and suspenseful discovery. You’ll scan beautifully detailed scenes for cleverly concealed items and put your brain to the test with engaging mini-games. It’s a genre where curiosity is rewarded, and every object found brings you closer to the truth!

Step into a seemingly idyllic medieval-themed park filled with majestic castles, gallant knights, and old-world charm. But when tourists begin to vanish without explanation, you’re pulled into a haunting tale that defies time. A dying man’s cryptic warning and a spine-chilling video point to something sinister: a ghostly knight guarding secrets from a kingdom lost to history. The further you go, the deeper the illusion breaks—and you may find yourself not just an observer, but a threat to this frozen realm.

Embark on a thrilling journey where you’ll explore eerie locations, unravel spectral mysteries, and challenge your perception of reality. To survive and solve the mystery, you'll need sharp eyes, clever thinking, and the courage to step into the unknown.

This Collector's Edition includes:

🕯️ Solve layered mini-games and medieval puzzles hiding in the shadows of crumbling castles!

🕯️ Dive into Hidden-Object scenes across multiple hauntingly atmospheric locations!

🕯️ Unlock achievements that showcase your progress and prowess!

🕯️ Collect lost relics and curious artifacts scattered throughout the ghostly realm!

🕯️ Enjoy a captivating soundtrack and unlock beautiful wallpapers!

🕯️ Find dozens of hidden objects waiting to be discovered!

The past is calling. Will you answer before it’s too late? Dive into Mind Echoes: Remnants of the Past and begin your quest today!
